identity_check: Confirmed as Uptool (uptool.com), the San Mateo, California startup founded in 2024 that sells AI quoting software to small and midsize U.S. machine and fabrication shops. The company site (home, company, pricing), Eclipse's portfolio page for Uptool, Venture Capital Access Online (4 Feb 2026), Pulse 2.0 (10 Feb 2026) and 3DPrint.com (11 Feb 2026) all describe the same product and the same co-founders (Benny Buller, CEO and founder of Velo3D; Alex Huckstepp, ex-Machina Labs and Carbon). Matched on the domain and the RFQ-quoting description, not the name alone; not usamachineshops.com, a shop directory the Uptool site links to. Category set to direct (not in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 seed list; candidate seen in Eclipse's portfolio, whose Axios source was blocked): Uptool automates the RFQ-to-quote workflow for shops — ingesting quote emails, CAD files, engineering drawings and BOMs, computing operations, materials and costs — which is Utopian Autonomy's RFQ / BOM / engineering-drawing function. Differences: its users are estimators and owners at job shops answering customers' RFQs (the supplier side), not plant staff at the buying factory; delivery is a web dashboard plus the shop's quoting inbox, not WhatsApp; it does not cover procurement, maintenance or process stability, though it plans CRM and job tracking next. Layer process_planning, as for Forgepoint.

company.name: Uptool
company.description: San Mateo startup selling AI quoting software that turns RFQ emails, CAD files, drawings and BOMs into priced quotes for small U.S. machine and fab shops.

layer_detail: RFQ-to-quote automation for job shops: connects to the shop's quoting inbox, gathers RFQ documents (CAD files, engineering drawings, BOMs) into a dashboard, captures operations and costs with material and operations calculators, applies shop rates and markups, and tracks revisions and customer conversations. Claims 90% of the RFQ-to-quote workflow automated and per-part quoting cut from 20 to 2 minutes. Users are estimators and owners at small and midsize machine and fabrication shops (supplier side). Roadmap per press: CRM and job tracking toward a shop operating system. Web app, no WhatsApp channel seen.
product_summary: Web platform for machine and fab shops that pulls incoming RFQs and their CAD files, drawings and BOMs into one dashboard, estimates operations, materials and cost, applies the shop's rates and markups to draft the quote, and tracks revisions and customer conversations; set-up takes about an hour.
pricing: Free 1-week trial ('$0 for any U.S. shop < 100 ppl'); paid plan 'Starts at $195+ /month dependent on total employees & ITAR' (uptool.com/pricing).
